maddeler.e:
أنحذف (form VII)
# أَنْحَذِفُ (ʔanḥaḏifu) /ʔan.ħa.ði.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
# أَنْحَذِفَ (ʔanḥaḏifa) /ʔan.ħa.ði.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
# أَنْحَذِفْ (ʔanḥaḏif) /ʔan.ħa.ðif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
